title: Calibrate multi-tier alert fusion and severity reassignment after capacity regression
creator: Ari Jacobs
description: Postmortem action item from the 2026-03-07 capacity regression where sustained autoscaler oscillation caused cascading SLO burn alerts and noisy paging. Goal: redesign alert fusion and severity assignment so that (a) pages surface high-confidence user-visible SLO breaches, (b) on-call noise is reduced, and (c) capacity regressions still trigger operational workflows without overwhelming responders. This ticket covers design, a prototype implementation in the alert router, and canary rollout with metrics-driven acceptance criteria.
proposed_actions: Introduce an 'alert fusion' layer that groups temporally adjacent burn-rate and per-route error signals into a single incident candidate before paging

Implement severity reassignment rules: degrade to P2 when an alert is low-confidence (transient spike or lacks correlated user impact), promote to P0/P1 only when multiple independent SLIs cross thresholds or downstream customer-facing traces show errors
Apply hysteresis windows per-tier (short window for P0, longer for P2) to avoid flapping during autoscaler churn
Add a weighted deduplication step that boosts alerts correlated with regression-related classifier signals (autoscaler events, rollout flags) while suppressing singleton statistical spikes
Expose a 'synthetic gating' flag to temporarily mute pages for known synthetic-only regressions (e.g., worker health probes) while keeping dashboards and alerts visible to SRE
Create a canary rollout: start with non-paging mode for 24h on staging routes, then 48h on low-traffic customer tier, then global with staged oncall reassignments
Update runbooks and oncall playbooks to include the new fusion/assign heuristics and escalation flows
Instrument new metrics: fused_alert_rate, fused_alert_confidence, paging_reduction_pct, false_positive_rate_estimate, and avg_time_to_ack_by_severity
acceptance_criteria: Paging volume attributable to regression-related noise reduced by >=60% on canary routes without increasing missed high-confidence SLO breaches by >5%
Fused alert confidence correlates with human-validated incidents at >=85% precision in 2-week pilot
New metrics emitted in console dashboards and alert router traces; synthetic gating flag visible in Incident console
Runbook updated and reviewed by SRE and Product; oncall rotation updated with rollout notes
